simple.meaning: יֵצֶר (Yêtser) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jetser , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יֵצֶר (H3337) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 46:24, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יֵצֶר (H3337) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יֵצֶר (H3337) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יֵצֶר (Yêtser) / H3337 is traced through Genesis 46:24, Numbers 26:49, 1 Chronicles 7:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
